summary: Bind construction criterion evidence to the actual package fingerprint and versioned manifest bytes.
details: Real construction rows contain commit/tree in source and their validated package fingerprint separately. The criterion writer now projects that fingerprint into its source binding instead of dropping it.

Packaging criteria select the v1 or v2 construction descriptor and require both the accepted canonical record hash and actual manifest file hash. A reformatted copy with the same canonical hash is refused.

Portable writer controls model the actual row shape for both manifest versions, verify all criterion source bindings, preserve the general-FPS refusal and reject byte-substituted construction observations without creating output. Owned disposable writer fixtures are removed after checks.
Packaging propositions do not establish native criteria, complete release acceptance, engine qualification, signing, promotion, support or publication authority. Those outcomes remain outstanding.
